text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand trains hard for the Hanshin 
Daishoten. With each day spent building 
endurance, her confidence also seemed to 
steadily grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hanshin Daishoten had 
arrived. Under the gaze of the gathered 
fans and her sisters, Cheval Grand 
declared that she came here today to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the dream of becoming a "Great 
Umamusume"— she faces her childhood 
friend, Shine Praise, in a direct 
showdown!
